notices.title: No work permit needed
notices.body: Citizens of the EU, of Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway, and of Switzerland, can live and work in Germany, France, Spain and the Netherlands under free movement — the routes on this site are for other passports. Check registration rules after arrival (e.g. Anmeldung in Germany).

source.quote: As an EU national you generally don't need a work permit to work anywhere in the EU.
source.legal_basis: TFEU art. 45 (free movement of workers) — Your Europe

notices.title: Türkiye: extra rights once you are legally employed
notices.body: Your route options are the same as for any other non-EU passport: the EU–Türkiye agreement adds rights once you are legally working, rather than a separate way in. Where an authority states that its own requirements differ for Turkish citizens, that route's card says so — the Dutch orientation year is one.

source.quote: As a national of Türkiye, your rights to live and work in an EU country depend entirely on the national rules of that country. When employed legally in the EU, you enjoy the same working conditions as the nationals of that country and you have the following rights: after one year's legal employment you are entitled to a renewal of your work permit for the same employer if a job is available after three years' legal employment you may change employers and respond to any other employment offer within the same professional qualifications after four years' legal employment you enjoy full access to any paid employment in that EU country.
source.legal_basis: EEC–Turkey Association Agreement, Decision 1/80 art. 6 — Your Europe

routes.name: EU Blue Card — shortage occupation
routes.summary: A lower salary threshold, for occupations on Germany's shortage list — IT, engineering, health and others.

threshold.quote: Personen mit einem Mangelberuf und Berufseinsteigende können die Blaue Karte EU auch mit einem geringeren Bruttojahresgehalt beantragen, welches 2026 45.934,20 Euro beträgt.
threshold.legal_basis: § 18g AufenthG

statements.text: A concrete job offer from an employer in Germany, for work of at least six months

source.quote: Eine weitere Voraussetzung für die Blaue Karte EU ist ein konkretes Stellenangebot von einem Arbeitgeber in Deutschland mit einer Beschäftigungsdauer von mindestens sechs Monaten.

statements.text: If your profession is regulated, the licence to practise it must already be in hand

source.quote: Handelt es sich um einen reglementierten Beruf, muss zusätzlich eine Berufsausübungserlaubnis vorliegen.

routes.name: EU Blue Card — general
routes.summary: The standard EU Blue Card: a recognised university degree and a salary above the general threshold, in any qualified job.

threshold.quote: Für die „große“ Blaue Karte EU muss ein Mindestbruttojahresgehalt erreicht werden, welches im Jahr 2026 50.700 Euro beträgt.
threshold.legal_basis: § 18g AufenthG

statements.text: A concrete job offer from an employer in Germany, for work of at least six months

source.quote: Eine weitere Voraussetzung für die Blaue Karte EU ist ein konkretes Stellenangebot von einem Arbeitgeber in Deutschland mit einer Beschäftigungsdauer von mindestens sechs Monaten.

statements.text: If your profession is regulated, the licence to practise it must already be in hand

source.quote: Handelt es sich um einen reglementierten Beruf, muss zusätzlich eine Berufsausübungserlaubnis vorliegen.

routes.name: Skilled worker — academic (§ 18b)
routes.summary: Your university degree is recognised in Germany and the job matches it. There is no salary threshold — but from age 45 an extra salary requirement applies, or proof of pension provision.

source.quote: Proof of a German or recognised foreign university degree or a foreign university degree which is comparable to a German university degree

statements.text: A job that can be done with the university qualification you hold

source.quote: Presentation of a concrete job offer or an employment contract for a job that can be performed with this academic qualification.

routes.name: Skilled worker — vocational (§ 18a)
routes.summary: Your vocational training is recognised in Germany and you have a job offer that matches it. There is no salary threshold — but from age 45 an extra salary requirement applies.

source.quote: vocational qualifications acquired abroad which are equivalent to qualified German vocational training

readings.text: How much German you need depends on the job itself. The page we watch states that condition for Germany’s job-seeking permit, not for this route, so it is our expectation and not the authority’s words.
You will also need enough income to live on without state support, and health cover; the salary from the job normally covers both. No page we watch states either condition for this route.

routes.name: Experienced worker (§ 19c / § 6 BeschV)
routes.summary: No German recognition needed: two years of recent skilled work in the last five, plus either a qualification your home country officially recognises, or experience in IT.

source.quote: Innerhalb der letzten fünf Jahren muss eine mindestens zweijährige, einschlägige Berufserfahrung auf dem Niveau einer Fachkraft gesammelt worden sein.
eine ausländische Berufsqualifikation, die von dem Staat, in dem sie erworben wurde, staatlich anerkannt ist und deren Erlangung eine Ausbildungsdauer von mindestens zwei Jahren vorausgesetzt hat
source.legal_basis: § 6 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 3 Buchst. a BeschV

source.quote: In Berufen auf dem Gebiet der Informations- und Kommunikationstechnologie findet Satz 1 Nummer 3 keine Anwendung.

criteria.threshold_label: 45% of the German pension contribution ceiling

threshold.quote: mind. 45.630 Euro im Jahr 2026
threshold.legal_basis: § 6 BeschV (45% der Beitragsbemessungsgrenze)

statements.text: The salary threshold can be set aside if your employer is bound by a collective wage agreement and employs you on its agreed terms — we do not ask about collective agreements.

source.quote: Von der Gehaltsschwelle kann nur abgewichen werden, wenn der Arbeitgeber tarifgebunden im Sinne des §§ 3 und 5 Tarifvertragsgesetz (TVG) ist und die Beschäftigung zu den geltenden tariflichen Bedingungen erfolgt.

statements.text: Your qualification must be officially recognised in the country where you earned it

source.quote: Die Qualifikation muss in dem Staat, in dem sie erworben wurde, staatlich anerkannt sein.

routes.name: Researcher (§ 18d)
routes.summary: A research institution — from a university to a company's research department — has agreed to host you and to cover the costs. The permit runs for at least a year, and you may stay 18 months afterwards to look for work.

source.quote: concluded a hosting agreement or corresponding contract with a research facility to carry out a research project

statements.text: A hosting agreement, or an equivalent contract, concluded with a research facility for a research project

source.quote: you will need to have concluded a hosting agreement or corresponding contract with a research facility to carry out a research project

routes.name: ICT Card — intra-corporate transfer (§ 19)
routes.summary: Your company moves you to its German branch for more than 90 days, as a manager, specialist or trainee. Up to three years, or one year for trainees.

source.quote: you have been employed by the undertaking or group of undertakings for at least six months

statements.text: A transfer of more than 90 days, in a manager, specialist or trainee role

source.quote: the intra-corporate transfer is to last longer than 90 days

statements.text: At least six months already employed by the company or group, and still with it throughout the transfer

source.quote: you have been employed by the undertaking or group of undertakings for at least six months, and belong to the undertaking uninterruptedly for the period of the transfer,

routes.name: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte, § 20a)
routes.summary: A one-year card to come and look for work, with part-time work of up to 20 hours a week. If your qualification is fully recognised in Germany you get it directly; otherwise you need six points from the official table. Having an offer does not stop you applying — but with an offer the work routes may fit you directly, so compare them.

source.quote: einen ausländischen Hochschulabschluss, einen mindestens zweijährigen Berufsabschluss (jeweils im Ausbildungsstaat staatlich anerkannt)

criteria.label: a language to start with
criteria.short_reason: German at A1 (beginner) or better, or English at B2 (upper intermediate) or better

source.quote: der Ausländer a) mindestens einfache deutsche Sprachkenntnisse nachweist oder b) englische Sprachkenntnisse mindestens auf dem Niveau B2 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen nachweist.

threshold.quote: Für den Aufenthalt in Deutschland müssen Ihnen monatlich mindestens 1.091 Euro zur Verfügung stehen.
threshold.legal_basis: § 20a AufenthG (Lebensunterhalt)

source.quote: Die Chancenkarte kann einem Ausländer erteilt werden, wenn 1. er eine Fachkraft ist

statements.text: The card allows work of up to 20 hours a week on average, plus trial work of up to two weeks at a time. That is a limit on what it lets you do, not a condition of getting it — weigh it against a work route with a full-time job.

source.quote: Die Chancenkarte berechtigt nur dazu, 1. eine Beschäftigung von durchschnittlich insgesamt höchstens 20 Stunden je Woche auszuüben und 2. eine Probebeschäftigung für jeweils höchstens zwei Wochen auszuüben
source.legal_basis: § 20a Absatz 2 AufenthG (consolidated mirror — gesetze-im-internet.de times out from here)

routes.name: Talent — qualified employee (salarié qualifié)
routes.summary: For people who earned a master's-level degree in France and have a contract of more than three months. The card lasts as long as the contract, up to four years, and the job does not have to be advertised first.

source.quote: Avoir un contrat de travail de plus de 3 mois
Avoir obtenu en France un diplôme au moins équivalent au master

threshold.quote: Avoir un contrat de travail de plus de 3 mois qui prévoit une rémunération brute annuelle supérieure ou égale à 39 582 €.
threshold.legal_basis: CESEDA — carte de séjour talent (fiche F16922)

readings.text: This is France's track for people who studied in France. With a degree from anywhere else, the European Blue Card is the card that fits — its own page on this site.

statements.text: An employment contract of more than three months

source.quote: Avoir un contrat de travail de plus de 3 mois

routes.name: EU Blue Card (talent — carte bleue européenne)
routes.summary: A contract of at least six months, plus a higher-education diploma of three years or more — or five years of comparable experience. Up to four years, and the job does not have to be advertised first.

source.quote: Avoir un contrat de travail de 6 mois minimum
Avoir un diplôme sanctionnant au moins 3 années d'études supérieures ou 5 années d'expérience professionnelle de niveau comparable

threshold.quote: Avoir une rémunération annuelle brute supérieure ou égale à 1,5 fois le salaire brut moyen annuel de référence, soit 59 373,00 € brut annuel.
threshold.legal_basis: CESEDA — carte talent, carte bleue européenne (fiche F16922)

readings.text: For some listed professions France counts three years of experience in the last seven instead of five. We do not model that list, so this card judges you on the general rule.

statements.text: An employment contract of at least six months

source.quote: Avoir un contrat de travail de 6 mois minimum

routes.name: ICT — seconded employee (salarié détaché ICT)
routes.summary: Your group moves you to France for an assignment of more than a year, in a senior or expert role. Up to three years, and it cannot be renewed.

source.quote: Vous avez une ancienneté d'au moins 6 mois dans le groupe qui vous emploie

criteria.threshold_label: resources, at the French minimum wage level

threshold.quote: Justificatif de ressources supérieures ou égales à 1 867,02 € brut par mois
threshold.legal_basis: CESEDA — carte salarié détaché ICT (fiche F33952)

readings.text: The French page states this figure as proof of resources rather than a salary an employer must pay, and it tracks the French minimum wage — expect it to move when that is revalued.

statements.text: At least six months with the group that employs you

source.quote: Vous avez une ancienneté d'au moins 6 mois dans le groupe qui vous emploie.

statements.text: An assignment lasting more than a year

source.quote: La carte de séjour pluriannuelle salarié détaché ICT permet de séjourner en France pour effectuer une mission de plus d'1 an lors d'un transfert temporaire intragroupe

statements.text: You must come to fill a senior management post, or to bring specialist expertise

source.quote: Vous venez en France pour occuper un poste d'encadrement supérieur ou apporter une expertise

routes.name: Talent — employee of an innovative company
routes.summary: For a job at a company France officially recognises as innovative, in work tied to its research and development. The salary threshold is the same as the qualified-employee card, and no French degree is needed.

source.quote: Avoir des fonctions en lien direct avec le projet de recherche et de développement de cette entreprise
source.legal_basis: Fiche F16922 — salarié en mission ou entreprise innovante

criteria.short_reason: an employer France recognises as innovative

source.quote: Être recruté dans une jeune entreprise innovante ou une entreprise reconnue innovante par le ministère de l'économie

threshold.quote: Avoir un contrat de travail qui prévoit une rémunération brute annuelle supérieure ou égale à 39 582 €.
threshold.legal_basis: CESEDA — carte talent-salarié qualifié, parcours entreprise innovante (fiche F16922)

statements.text: Work directly tied to that company’s research and development project

source.quote: Avoir des fonctions en lien direct avec le projet de recherche et de développement de cette entreprise

statements.text: The employer must be a young innovative company, or a company France’s ministry of the economy recognises as innovative

source.quote: Être recruté dans une jeune entreprise innovante ou une entreprise reconnue innovante par le ministère de l'économie

routes.name: Talent — employee on assignment (salarié en mission)
routes.summary: For an intra-group move to France where the French company issues your contract. Unlike the ICT card, the contract is French and the salary rule is the talent threshold.

source.quote: Être salarié d'une entreprise établie à l'étranger et venir en France pour exercer une activité salariée dans le cadre d'une mobilité entre établissements d'une même entreprise ou entre entreprises d'un même groupe (mobilité intragroupe)

criteria.short_reason: a contract with the French entity

source.quote: Avoir un contrat de travail avec l'entreprise qui vous emploie en France

threshold.quote: Percevoir une rémunération brute annuelle supérieure ou égale à 39 582 €.
threshold.legal_basis: CESEDA — carte talent-salarié qualifié, parcours salarié en mission (fiche F16922)

statements.text: At least three months with the group that employs you

source.quote: Avoir une ancienneté d'au moins 3 mois dans le groupe qui vous emploie

statements.text: Employment by a company established abroad, and a move between branches of that company or between companies of the same group

source.quote: Être salarié d'une entreprise établie à l'étranger et venir en France pour exercer une activité salariée dans le cadre d'une mobilité entre établissements d'une même entreprise ou entre entreprises d'un même groupe (mobilité intragroupe)

routes.name: EU Blue Card (tarjeta azul-UE)
routes.summary: A contract or firm offer of at least six months, plus a higher-education qualification of three years or more — or five years of comparable experience. Spain's large-companies unit decides in 20 working days, and if it does not answer in time the application counts as approved. A lower salary applies if you earned your qualification in the last three years.

source.quote: un contrato de trabajo válido o una oferta firme de empleo de alta cualificación para un período de al menos seis meses
acrediten un mínimo de cinco años de conocimientos, capacidades y competencias avalados por una experiencia profesional que pueda considerarse equiparable a dicha cualificación
una cualificación derivada de una formación de enseñanza superior de duración mínima de tres años y equivalente al menos al Nivel 2 del Marco Español de Cualificaciones para la Educación Superior

criteria.threshold_label: standard amount (1.4× the Spanish average wage)

threshold.quote: Nuevos umbrales salariales Tarjeta Azul. - Umbral general: 41.356,36 €
threshold.legal_basis: Ley 14/2013 art. 71 bis + Orden PJC/44/2026 (1,4× ganancia media INE)

paths.label: the lower salary for a recent qualification

criteria.short_reason: a qualification from the last 3 years

criteria.threshold_label: lower amount for a qualification from the last 3 years

statements.text: The lower salary can also apply to shortage occupations that fall in the managerial and professional groups of Spain’s occupation classification (CNO-2011 groups 1 and 2) — we do not check that list.

source.quote: ¿Cuándo se aplica el umbral reducido? El umbral reducido podrá aplicarse en los siguientes supuestos: - Ocupaciones de difícil cobertura incluidas en los grupos 1 y 2 de la CNO-2011, conforme a la normativa vigente.
source.legal_basis: Ley 14/2013 art. 71 bis + Orden PJC/44/2026 (supuestos del umbral reducido), as the UGE umbral-salarial PDF states them, edición Junio 2026.

statements.text: The application must be handled by Spain's large-companies unit (UGE), and it is the Directorate-General for Migration that grants it

readings.text: Spain's law gives IT professionals and managers a shorter experience route of their own. We do not model it, so this card judges you on the general rule.

Whether the lower salary is limited to qualifications from particular institutions is a question the ministry’s sheet does not answer: it names no institution anywhere. We apply the lower salary with no such limit, the wording the law itself uses.

routes.name: Highly qualified professional (profesional altamente cualificado)
routes.summary: Spain's national fast-track for higher-education professionals, or people with equivalent experience, hired by a qualifying employer. One salary threshold, with no reduced version, decided in 20 working days.

criteria.short_reason: at least three years of related experience

una titulación equiparable al menos al nivel 1 del Marco Español de Cualificaciones para la Educación Superior

routes.summary: The same permit with a lower salary for people under 30 — and lower still if, within the last three years, you graduated from a Dutch university or research institution, or from a foreign institution the Dutch immigration service designates.

routes.name: EU Blue Card
routes.summary: A contract of at least six months, plus a higher-education diploma of three years or more — or five years of relevant experience, three years if you work in information technology. Your employer does not have to be a recognised sponsor. A lower salary counts for a degree holder who graduated in the last three years from a Dutch institution, or from a foreign one the Dutch immigration service designates.

source.quote: Your employment contract is valid for at least 6 months.
you have a minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience

you have a diploma of a programme in higher education. This programme was at least 3 years.

routes.name: Intra-corporate transferee (Directive 2014/66/EU)
routes.summary: Your company moves you to the Netherlands as a manager, specialist or trainee. The salary has to reach the highly skilled migrant level for your age. Up to three years, or one for trainees.

routes.summary: A contract or hosting agreement with a Dutch research institution the immigration service (IND) recognises as a sponsor. Up to five years.

statements.text: If your Dutch employer pays you no salary, a grant, a stipend, money from a sponsor or enough money in your own account can meet this instead.

source.quote: Will you not receive a salary from your Dutch employer? Then you must have other income, for example a grant, stipend or money from a sponsor. Or you have sufficient money in your bank account for the time you are in the Netherlands.

statements.text: The research institute must be a sponsor the Dutch immigration service (IND) recognises, listed in the public register of recognised sponsors

source.quote: This research institute (hereinafter referred to as: employer) is a recognised sponsor. You can check the public register of recognised sponsors whether your employer has been recognised as a sponsor.

statements.text: A higher education degree that gives access to a doctoral programme, or your employer’s declaration that you have the appropriate level

source.quote: You have a higher education degree. This degree gives you access to the doctoral programme. Your employer determines whether your degree is suitable. Do you not have a suitable degree? Then your employer must declare that you have the appropriate level.

routes.name: Orientation year (zoekjaar)
routes.summary: A one-year permit to look for work — any job, no separate work permit, and it cannot be extended. The Dutch immigration service (IND) grants it after certain studies, doctorates or research finished in the three years before you apply; its list of qualifying programmes and institutions is longer than the two cases asked about here, so read its own page before ruling yourself out. Having a job offer does not stop you applying — but with an offer the work routes may fit you directly, so compare them.

paths.label: a Dutch university or research institution

source.quote: An accredited bachelor’s or master’s degree programme at a Dutch higher education institution.

paths.label: a foreign institution the Dutch immigration service designates

source.quote: A master’s degree programme, a doctoral programme or a post-master’s study programme at a designated foreign educational institution
You completed one of the following study programmes in the 3 years before the date of application:

statements.text: You must not have previously held an orientation year permit for the same study programme, doctorate or research.

source.quote: You have not previously held a residence permit for an orientation year for the same research for which you are now applying. Nor have you held such a permit following the completion of the same study programme or doctoral programme.

statements.text: If you hold a Turkish passport, the Dutch immigration service says the requirements for you and your family may be different. It does not say how, so read its own page before relying on the answer above.

source.legal_basis: Dutch immigration service, Residence permit for orientation year — Requirements

statements.text: The scientific research must have been carried out in the Netherlands in the three years before the date of application

source.quote: You have conducted scientific research in the Netherlands in the 3 years before the date of application.

statements.text: If you studied at a foreign educational institution the Dutch immigration service (IND) designates, you must also meet one of its further requirements: a score of at least 6.0 on the IELTS English test or another accepted test, or a programme that was taught in English or Dutch

source.quote: If you have completed your course or programme at a designated foreign educational institution, you must also meet one of the following requirements: You obtained a minimum score of 6.0 on a test in the International English Language Testing System (IELTS).

readings.text: The Dutch immigration service lists five situations that open this route. We model the two that turn on where and when you studied; the other three — research done here, an Erasmus Mundus master, a permit you already held — are not asked about anywhere on this site.
